My research explores complex fluid dynamics, fluid–structure interactions, and the mathematical modeling of biological locomotion.

A selection of publications is listed below, with links to journal articles or publicly available versions. For a complete
publication history and additional professional information,
see my [curriculum vitae](files/Thomases_CV.pdf).
